eps.o: Steve Harvey hosts a look back at the past few decades of "Family Feud," highlighting fan-favorite moments from the iconic series.

eps.t: Megan Thee Stallion vs. Ne-Yo and NFL vs. Olympians
eps.o: Megan Thee Stallion goes head-to-head with NE-YO; NFL athletes battle it out with Olympians for their selected charities.

eps.t: Meghan Trainor vs. Tori Kelly and Golden Bachelor vs. Bachelor Nation
eps.o: Celebrity contestants Meghan Trainor and Tori Kelly.

eps.t: Robin Thicke vs. Anthony Anderson and Walker Hayes vs. Rachel Bilson
eps.o: Celebrity contestants Robin Thicke, Anthony Anderson, Walker Hayes and Rachel Bilson.

eps.t: Daughtry vs. Papa Roach and Earth, Wind & Fire vs. The War & Treaty
eps.o: Daughtry and Papa Roach face off; Earth, Wind & Fire go up against The War And Treaty for their selected charities.

eps.t: Fat Joe vs. Gabriel "Fluffy" Iglesias and David Foster & Katharine McPhee vs. Clay Aiken
eps.o: Fat Joe goes head-to-head with Gabriel “Fluffy” Iglesias; and later, David Foster and Katharine McPhee battle it out with Clay Aiken to see who will win the grand prize for their selected charities.

eps.t: Flavor Flav vs. Bobby Lee and Donny Osmond vs. Ken Marino
eps.o: Flavor Flav battles it out with Bobby Lee to win the grand prize. In the next game, Donny Osmond and Ken Marino face off.

eps.t: Men of WWE vs. Women of WWE and Candace Parker vs. Lisa Leslie
eps.o: The men and women of WWE face off; Candace Parker and Lisa Leslie go head-to-head.

eps.t: Fantasy Sweets vs. Golden Five and 9-1-1 vs. Jury Duty
eps.o: "The Golden Bachelor" fan-favorites face off; the casts of "9-1-1" and "Jury Duty" compete.

eps.t: Chrissy Teigen & John Legend vs. David Chang and Deadliest Catch vs. Star Trek Universe
eps.o: Celebrity contestants Chrissy Teigen, John Legend and David Chang.

eps.t: Family Feud: The Best of Steve Harvey
eps.o: A special looking back at the last few decades of "Family Feud," highlighting iconic moments and Steve's funniest jokes from the series.

This special holiday episode filled with holiday cheer, features teams led by Shaquille O'Neal and Sherri Shepherd as they battle it out to see who will win the grand prize for their selected charities.
